thread:
Maya Chen: Drafting a compact launch playbook for enterprise buyers. Goal: 1-pager + benchmark snippet + 3-email nurture + webinar. Dropped a doc at https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-playbook-v1
Ben Ortiz: Nice. For the benchmark snippet we should frame as 'typical production ranges' with a conservative example for each deployment mode. Keep it three lines max.
Zoe Kim: I can write the social + blog intro. Suggest the narrative 'control vs convenience' 10 lines max for blog hook.
Maya Chen: Love "control vs convenience" phrasing. I'll add that as the hero line on the one-pager.
Tara Li: Webinar plan: 25 min demo, 15 min customer panel (security lead), 10 min live Q&A. Need to lock a customer and a field rep.
Lucas M.: I can coordinate with the FinServ partner for the panelist. Will check availability for week of 2025-12-01.
Maya Chen: Added webinar CTA copy variations for A/B test:
A) "Secure inference at scale: live demo + SLA patterns"
B) "How teams meet SLAs for regulated LLM apps"
Which do we prefer for paid LinkedIn ads?
Ben Ortiz: Use A for ads (shorter). Use B in direct email to known compliance contacts.
Zoe Kim: Social caption draft: "Modern apps need predictable inference. Join our briefing to learn how teams reduce latency, control costs, and keep data private."
Maya Chen: Added a short benchmark box to the one-pager: "Conservative p95 example: Hosted 400ms ($8/1k tokens); Dedicated 180ms ($5/1k); Private 200ms ($6/1k)" with parenthetical note that numbers vary by model & seq length.
Tara Li: Add explicit routing fields for leads so Field Ops can triage in Salesforce. Suggested mapping: lead.vertical, lead.annual_spend_est, lead.compliance_level, lead.needs_private_deploy.
Maya Chen: Draft SFDC routing mapping in the doc:
```
SFDC Lead fields -> Routing
- Vertical -> queue:enterprise_sales / selfserve
- Annual_Spend_Est -> if > 250k -> dedicated_sales
- Compliance_Level -> if 'high' -> enterprise_sales + Tara Li
- Needs_Private_Deploy -> if true -> private-deploy-team@redwood.ai
```
Lucas M.: Can we add a webhook sample for the marketing form to auto-populate Needs_Private_Deploy boolean?
Maya Chen: Yup added webhook example snippet and a note: 'ask infra contact and yes/no for on-prem/VPC'.
Ben Ortiz: For the one-pager messaging, include 3 quick bullets on security controls: KMS/HSM + audit logs + private control plane. Make them punchy.
Maya Chen: Done. Also added 'SLA bands' microcopy: Bronze (99.5%, best effort), Silver (99.95%), Gold (99.99% with reserved capacity).
Zoe Kim: Blog outline: 1) Problem statement 2) How deployment mode maps to control & cost 3) Benchmark highlights 4) Case study blurbs 5) CTA to webinar. I'll make it ~600 words.
Tara Li: Nurture sequence idea: Day 0 register -> immediate asset; Day 3 send benchmark deep-dive; Day 7 send customer case + call to action to book field meeting. Include UTM for tracking.
Maya Chen: Uploaded initial assets to drive and linked in doc. Also added UTM examples for tracking in the nurture emails.
ops-bot: Webinar event scheduled: 2025-12-04 17:00 UTC. Registration: https://events.redwood.ai/enterprise-briefing
Lucas M.: Field Ops, when design finalizes the hero, can you produce the one-slide cheat-sheet and a 1-page PDF?
Field Ops: Yes, will produce both after final copy. Expect 36-48 hours from design approval.
Ben Ortiz: Quick legal check: can we say '99.99% uptime' in marketing? Need to ensure that's only used with SLA addendum language. Legal flagged it before.
Maya Chen: Noted. I'll add parentheses that Gold requires a reserved capacity contract and SLA addendum.
Zoe Kim: Landing page microcopy for paid ads: headline, subhead, 3 bullets + CTA. I put a draft. Feedback?
Ben Ortiz: Subhead tweak: emphasize 'predictable latency' rather than cost. Compliance buyers care about predictability first.
Maya Chen: Updated subhead to 'Predictable latency and controls for regulated applications.'
Tara Li: For the AEs: added 3 objection response snippets in the doc for quick copy-paste into emails.
Maya Chen: Final checklist: finalize copy by EOD Friday, send to design, lock webinar guests, create event page, set A/B email test Monday. Any blockers?
Lucas M.: No blockers from field; syncing with partner now.
Ben Ortiz: No blockers from growth.
Tara Li: I'll verify compliance blurbs with security and confirm routing playbook.
Maya Chen: Great. Locking the doc for final edits and tagging @design. Thanks all :sparkles:
